vocabulary.meaning: Imagined rather than real; used to discuss unreal situations

meaning_translation.Hindi: वास्तविक नहीं, कल्पना पर आधारित; अवास्तविक स्थितियों पर चर्चा करने के लिए
meaning_translation.Japanese: 現実ではなく想像上の；非現実的な状況について話すときに使う

examples.sentence: If I had more free time, I would learn guitar. (This is a hypothetical situation.)

translation.Hindi: अगर मेरे पास अधिक खाली समय होता, तो मैं गिटार सीखता। (यह एक काल्पनिक स्थिति है।)
translation.Japanese: もし自由な時間がもっとあれば、ギターを習うだろう。（これは仮定の状況です）

vocabulary.meaning: Not expected to happen or be true

meaning_translation.Hindi: जिसके होने या सत्य होने की संभावना कम हो
meaning_translation.Japanese: 起こる・本当である可能性が低いこと

examples.sentence: If she won the lottery—though it’s unlikely—she would donate to charity.

translation.Hindi: यदि वह लॉटरी जीतती—हालाँकि यह कम संभावित है—तो वह दान करती।
translation.Japanese: もし彼女が宝くじに当たったら—可能性は低いが—慈善団体に寄付するだろう。

vocabulary.meaning: Something that must happen first for something else to happen

meaning_translation.Hindi: वह बात जो किसी अन्य बात के होने से पहले पूरी होनी चाहिए
meaning_translation.Japanese: 別のことが起こるために先に満たされるべき事柄

examples.sentence: If you studied harder, that condition would improve your results.

translation.Hindi: यदि तुम अधिक मेहनत से पढ़ते, तो वह शर्त तुम्हारे परिणाम सुधारती।
translation.Japanese: もっと勉強したなら、その条件によって成績は良くなるだろう。

vocabulary.meaning: What happens because of something else

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी अन्य कारण से होने वाली घटना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 他の出来事によって引き起こされること

examples.sentence: If I were taller, the result would be that I could reach the top shelf.

translation.Hindi: यदि मैं लंबा होता, तो परिणाम यह होता कि मैं ऊपरी शेल्फ तक पहुँच पाता।
translation.Japanese: もし私がもっと背が高ければ、上の棚に手が届くだろうという結果になる。

vocabulary.meaning: The part of a conditional sentence that states the condition (usually with 'if')

meaning_translation.Hindi: शर्त बताने वाला वाक्यांश, सामान्यतः 'if' से शुरू होता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 条件を述べる文の部分（通常 “if” で始まる）

examples.sentence: If I had a car, I would drive to work. ("If I had a car" is the if-clause.)

translation.Hindi: यदि मेरे पास कार होती, तो मैं काम पर कार से जाता। ("If I had a car" if-खंड है।)
translation.Japanese: もし車があれば、通勤に運転するだろう。（"If I had a car" が if節）

vocabulary.meaning: The part of the sentence that shows the result (often with 'would')

meaning_translation.Hindi: वाक्य का वह भाग जो परिणाम दिखाता है (अक्सर 'would' के साथ)
meaning_translation.Japanese: 結果を示す文の部分（多くは “would” を含む）

examples.sentence: If we lived by the sea, we would swim every morning. ("we would swim every morning" is the main clause.)

translation.Hindi: यदि हम समुद्र के पास रहते, तो हम हर सुबह तैरते। ("we would swim every morning" मुख्य उपवाक्य है।)
translation.Japanese: もし海辺に住んでいたら、毎朝泳ぐだろう。（"we would swim every morning" が主節）

vocabulary.meaning: A special form used after all subjects in unreal if-clauses (e.g., If I were you...)

meaning_translation.Hindi: अवास्तविक if-उपवाक्यों में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ प्रयुक्त विशेष रूप (जैसे, If I were you...)
meaning_translation.Japanese: 非現実の if 節で主語に関わらず用いる特別な形（例：If I were you...）

examples.sentence: If I were you, I would apologize.

translation.Hindi: अगर मैं तुम्हारी जगह होता, तो माफी मांगता।
translation.Japanese: もし私が君なら、謝るだろう。

vocabulary.meaning: Used to invite someone to imagine an unreal situation

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी अवास्तविक स्थिति की कल्पना करने के लिए प्रयुक्त
meaning_translation.Japanese: 非現実的な状況を想像させるために使う

examples.sentence: Suppose you lost your phone—what would you do?

translation.Hindi: मान लो तुम्हारा फोन खो गया—तुम क्या करते?
translation.Japanese: 仮に携帯をなくしたとしたら—どうする？

vocabulary.meaning: A formal structure where 'if' is dropped and the auxiliary comes before the subject

meaning_translation.Hindi: औपचारिक ढांचा जिसमें 'if' हटाकर सहायक क्रिया कर्ता से पहले आती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: “if” を省き、助動詞が主語の前に来る形式的な構文

examples.sentence: Were I rich, I would start a foundation.

translation.Hindi: यदि मैं अमीर होता, तो एक फाउंडेशन शुरू करता।
translation.Japanese: もし裕福であれば、基金を設立するだろう。

vocabulary.meaning: Used to express conditions meaning 'if not' (less common in second conditional but possible)

meaning_translation.Hindi: 'यदि नहीं' के अर्थ में प्रयुक्त (सेकंड कंडीशनल में कम सामान्य, पर संभव)
meaning_translation.Japanese: 「もし〜でなければ」の条件を表す（第二条件法ではやや珍しいが可能）

examples.sentence: I wouldn’t go out unless it were urgent.

translation.Hindi: मैं बाहर नहीं जाता जब तक कि वह जरूरी न होता।
translation.Japanese: 緊急でない限り、外出しないだろう。

grammar_tips.title: Core Form
grammar_tips.explanation: Second conditional describes unreal or unlikely situations in the present or future. Structure: If + past simple, would + base verb. Example: If I had a scooter, I would commute faster.

explanation_translation.Hindi: सेकंड कंडीशनल वर्तमान/भविष्य की अवास्तविक या कम संभावित स्थितियों के लिए होता है। संरचना: If + past simple, would + क्रिया का मूल रूप। उदाहरण: If I had a scooter, I would commute faster.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 第2条件法は現在・未来の非現実的または起こりにくい状況を表す。構文：If + 過去形，would + 動詞の原形。例：If I had a scooter, I would commute faster.

grammar_tips.title: ‘Were’ for All Subjects
grammar_tips.explanation: In unreal if-clauses, use 'were' after any subject (I/he/she/it). Example: If he were here, we would ask him.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अवास्तविक if-उपवाक्य में किसी भी कर्ता के बाद 'were' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: If he were here, we would ask him.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 非現実の if 節では主語に関係なく “were” を使う。例：If he were here, we would ask him.

grammar_tips.title: Comma and Clause Order
grammar_tips.explanation: Add a comma when the if-clause comes first: If I knew the answer, I would tell you. No comma when the main clause comes first: I would tell you if I knew the answer.

explanation_translation.Hindi: यदि if-उपवाक्य पहले आता है तो कॉमा लगाएँ: If I knew the answer, I would tell you. मुख्य उपवाक्य पहले हो तो कॉमा नहीं: I would tell you if I knew the answer.
explanation_translation.Japanese: if節が先ならカンマ：If I knew the answer, I would tell you. 主節が先ならカンマ不要：I would tell you if I knew the answer.

grammar_tips.title: Meaning vs. First Conditional
grammar_tips.explanation: Use second conditional for unreal/remote possibilities (If I won the lottery...). Use first conditional for real, likely results (If it rains, I will stay home).

explanation_translation.Hindi: अवास्तविक/दूर की संभावना के लिए सेकंड कंडीशनल (If I won the lottery...)। वास्तविक, संभावित परिणाम के लिए फर्स्ट कंडीशनल (If it rains, I will stay home).
explanation_translation.Japanese: 非現実・可能性が低い場合は第2条件法（If I won the lottery...）。現実的で起こりそうな場合は第1条件法（If it rains, I will stay home）。

grammar_tips.title: Polite Advice with ‘If I were you’
grammar_tips.explanation: For gentle advice, say: If I were you, I would + base verb. Example: If I were you, I would back up my files.

explanation_translation.Hindi: शिष्ट सलाह के लिए: If I were you, I would + क्रिया। उदाहरण: If I were you, I would back up my files.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 丁寧な助言には：If I were you, I would + 動詞原形。例：If I were you, I would back up my files.

grammar_tips.title: Formal Inversion (Advanced Option)
grammar_tips.explanation: In formal style, drop 'if' and invert: Were it less noisy, I would concentrate. Keep this for writing and formal speech.

explanation_translation.Hindi: औपचारिक शैली में 'if' हटाकर उलटाव करें: Were it less noisy, I would concentrate. इसे लेखन व औपचारिक बोलचाल के लिए रखें।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 形式的な文体では if を省略して倒置：Were it less noisy, I would concentrate. 文章やフォーマルな場面で使う。
